claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of California on Friday, April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The crew module began its atmospheric entry at 7:53 p.m. EDT.
Service module separation occurred at 7:33 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
Entry Interface occurred at 7:53 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
Reentry began at Entry Interface at approximately 400,000 ft.
Communication blackout occurred from 7:53 p.m. to 7:59 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
Astronauts were brought aboard the USS John P. Murtha.
